title: AS2 compiler: typeof operator missing
description: The AS2 compiler in packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts does not handle the typeof unary operator. typeof x should push the string 'string', 'number', 'boolean', 'object', 'function', 'undefined', or 'movieclip'. In AVM1, ActionTypeOf (opcode 0x44) performs this. Check if typeof is already handled in the UnaryExpr visitor; if not, add it by emitting ActionTypeOf.
